categories.name: Oracle
categories.content: Oracles are used by protocols in their smart contracts in order to obtain external data. This allows the closed-off blockchain environment to communicate with data points on the outside world. For example, a protocol offering synthetic Nasdaq-listed stock on the blockchain will need to pull external data from the stock market. With an oracle, the protocol will be able to do so.

categories.name: Trading Card RWA Platform
categories.content: Trading Card RWA Platforms tokenize physical collectible cards (e.g., Pokémon, sports cards) on a blockchain. The physical cards are stored with a custodian or vault, and each blockchain token represents ownership of the real-world card. This enables features such as fractional ownership and global secondary trading.
